title: What role does our home environment play in my child's therapy at Pinnacle Blooms?
metaTitle: Significance of Home Environment in Child's Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how the home environment significantly contributes to the effectiveness of therapy sessions for your child at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe that your home environment plays a vital role in your child's therapy. Our ABA, speech and autism therapies are intended to be integrated into your child's day-to-day life beyond the therapy sessions. Learning, practicing and mastering new skills in a secure, comforting and familiar home environment facilitates better retention and application. Our team provides parents with the guidance and resources needed to maintain consistency across the therapy sessions and your home.
